notes: I approve `advance_to_revised` as the rule-level cause for these 594 scheduled routine release events. The evidence supports the advance-to-revised process and concurrent seasonal adjustment, and the consistent 13–15-month revision pattern distinguishes these events from deeper annual benchmark revisions. The current agency source is from 2026, so application back to 2001 relies partly on the observed continuity of the revision pattern. This label describes the overall routine release event; it does not imply that every older observation changed within the event was itself an advance estimate, because some older movements may result from concurrent seasonal adjustment.
